items.en: We'll discuss the new transport project.
When will this project be implemented?
It's planned to start at the beginning of next year.
Was the residents' opinion taken into account?

items.uz: Hatto eng kichik tafsilotlar ham ko'rib chiqildi.
items.en: Even the smallest details were reviewed.

items.uz: Faqat moliyalashtirish masalasi hal qilinishi kerak.
items.en: Only the financing issue needs to be resolved.

items.uz: Umid qilamanki, bu loyiha shaharni yaxshilaydi.
items.en: I hope this project will improve the city.
